corridor_responsibilities.duty: Steward owns artillery death before his 4800 retreat. This FLY enemy cannot be held by the current ordinary ground-blocking rule; sufficient repeated arts damage is required. Both medics preserve Steward, and Spot preserves Hibiscus during her later lock waves.

Midnight clears eastern #3 without spending his first skill. The upper civilian must leave eastern artillery acquisition before the drone descends there. Returning Midnight clears western #1 and remains until actual safe arrival.
Melantha clears eastern #4 and intercepts lower officers upstream of western #2. Returning Melantha clears #2; require actual lower civilian arrival.

Fang hands upper inner containment to Spot. Midnight supplies available crossfire and his reserved armor window; Steward supplies approach damage, then direct central arts. Kill older upper armor before final armor would exceed Spot's three slots.

Friston holds the lower inner lane continuously. Opening Fang assists from above; returning Fang attacks from [4,4] and blocks downstream overflow. Spot's second healing window supports both blockers. Steward directly clears retained armor after returning.
Midnight retains upper outer interception until every assigned hostile is dead. His self-blocked targets take priority over inner assistance.
Melantha retains lower outer interception under Ansel. Her skill windows accelerate paired officers and final pressure. A surviving officer forbids the scheduled clearance handoff.

opening_economy.spot_funding: Fang's living retreat at 2430 refunds 5 DP before Spot deploys. Losing Fang before a credited grant or this refund breaks the survival and handoff chain.

formation_structure.redeployment_accounting: Fang, Steward, Midnight and Melantha each receive 2101 frames between retreat and redeployment. Current-model redeploy costs remain 10,18,16,15 respectively. Living refunds are 5,9,8,7; death refunds zero. Gross scheduled deployment expenditure is 172 DP, with 29 DP in scheduled refunds. No income after Fang's third grant is required.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: The selected/DEPLOY union contains exactly these eight catalog IDs, all normal_mode=true and rarity 1–3. No reserve units or aliases.
Every DEPLOY uses integer [row,col], legal terrain and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]], including after destruction.
Fang survives the three credited grants and retreats alive at 2430. Friston survives opening lower pressure with actual Fang/Midnight assistance. No absent rescue heal is credited.
Fang's upper queue is empty at withdrawal, or Spot actually reacquires every released enemy before escape. The one-frame replacement does not itself prove safe interception.
Initial splash recipients survive until medical boosts. Spot's first window delivers actual healing to Hibiscus between later locks; it supplies no healing to initial Steward or Ansel.
Eastern #3 is destroyed and its civilian moves beyond artillery acquisition before the drone's eastern descent can select it. Officer interception remains upstream of waiting civilians.
Artillery is dead and pending fixed-point shells are settled before Steward@4800. Ground blocking is not an artillery solution in this model.

Older upper armor dies before the final upper armor can exceed Spot's three-block capacity, approximately frame 6447 under uninterrupted model travel. Midnight's reserved skill must produce actual armor damage despite outer target competition.

Friston and returning Fang remain alive and retain sufficient combined capacity through final lower armor, whose unobstructed contact with [4,5] is approximately frame 6597. Require actual BLOCK and eventual death for #34.

Only deployed units receive actions. Retreat refunds require living units. Any death releases its actual queue and changes cooldown/funding dependencies; contribution is recorded, but later commands are not presumed valid.
Timeline checkpoints are predictions and verification obligations, not executable conditional branches. A missed handoff refutes this fixed candidate; no automatic retiming is assumed.
Require remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

Reserve the first skill for armor rather than opening device work. Credit ATK+35% only: 670.95 ATK yields 170.95 physical damage against 500 DEF. Do not assume arts conversion, critical hits or anti-air attacks.
Accelerate paired lower officers and final outer clearance. Credit supported ATK amplification only.
Use ordinary arts, supported highest-defense priority and automatic enhanced attacks. After artillery death, use remaining eastern exposure to damage initial armor before withdrawing.
Use ordinary three-block containment. Credit no unsupported deployment damage reduction.

tactical_thesis: Compress lower outer interception into permanent Melantha, replace Fang's upper inner position with Spot, and use Spot's supported healing to preserve Hibiscus through repeated artillery locks. Return Fang behind lower inner containment. Reserve Midnight's first skill for the first armored queue. Keep Steward east through artillery settlement and both initial armored approaches, then return him centrally after his real cooldown. This is an unexecuted full-stage hypothesis.
